claim_short: cat vs bobcat activity differs at co-occurrence sites
reasons: U2 reproduces exactly (0.189346 vs 0.189) | the conclusion depends on which null and which clock: as published, permutation p = 0.0465, but the within-site permutation that respects the 7 sites gives p = 0.0712 and a standard 30-min independent-event filter gives U2 = 0.1519, p = 0.0974 -- both above 0.05 | on the solar-time basis the Methods describe, p = 0.0231 and within-site p = 0.0378, both below 0.05 | v1 predicted this fragility from a design effect of 1.011; measured, it is real | 2 of 7 sites supply 91 of the 99 cat detections

claim_short: activity overlap much lower where species co-occur
reasons: both Dhat reproduce (0.8523 vs 0.852; 0.6467 vs 0.647, deposit plot 0.646) with overlap's Dhat1, the estimator the deposited script selects but the paper never names | the intervals the paper omits and the deposited script computes: solo 95% [0.729, 0.897], co-occurrence 95% [0.533, 0.805] -- they overlap | difference 0.206, 95% [-0.004, 0.308], includes zero; at site level [-0.068, 0.299] | verdict turns on how the claim is read: as 'Dhat differs' it is not resolved, but as 'cat activity differs between site classes' it is decisive (U2 = 1.515, p <= 5.0e-05) -- the paper should make the latter claim, which it never tests
